summary: A Bromley High Street private practice with Trustpilot reviews and composite bonding is a strength, but dead menu links and two booking routes appear to cost you patients.

findings.problem: The menu items About, Implants and Hygiene appear to link to #, and Single Implants and Dental Bridge Implants appear to share the same link.
findings.cost: Patients exploring treatments land nowhere or on the wrong page.

findings.problem: Two booking paths appear (an outside portal and a Book Appointment page), and a WhatsApp number appears in the header next to a different phone number with no explanation.
findings.cost: Patients do not know which route is correct, and some will give up.
findings.fix: One clear booking route and labelled contact options.

findings.problem: The text 'Dentist on Broley', 'Smilining' and 'Childern' appears in image text, and 'Hamburger Toggle Menu' appears as stray text.
findings.cost: Typos and leftover interface text make a clinic look careless.

findings.problem: Only one named testimonial appears, no clinicians are named, and the insurance FAQ appears to answer a different question.
findings.cost: Thin proof and a misleading answer weaken trust and cost bookings.
findings.fix: Named clinicians, more reviews and accurate FAQs.

redesign: Proofread copy, named clinicians and accurate FAQs.
